question: Should OpenClaw adopt this new durable AI-safety telemetry API in core and the plugin manifest, or keep safety-specific instrumentation outside the stable plugin contract until an owner-defined design exists?
rationale: The patch changes public plugin capabilities, authorization semantics, persistent operator data, and several product surfaces; source review cannot determine the intended permanent contract or retention policy.

options.title: Approve a narrow core contract
options.body: Sponsor a documented, versioned capability and privacy model, then require focused upgrade and end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the feature internal
options.body: Limit the work to core-owned diagnostics/exporter hooks and defer the plugin API, manifest capability, and operator UI until a separate design is approved.

options.title: Route optional integrations outward
options.body: Keep generic diagnostics stable and have safety-specific exporters or workflows evolve through plugins after the required extension seam is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a documented, versioned capability and privacy model, then require focused upgrade and end-to-end proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical request and the integrated implementation series, so they are the clearest available person to clarify the intended contract while a repository owner makes the final product decision.
